question: Under what optimized transesterification conditions (catalyst amount, methanol/oil ratio, temperature, time) was the maximum biodiesel yield obtained?
rendered:
Document: Engineering a GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 ternary nanocomposite for enhanced electrochemical performance and biodiesel catalysis, page 15

The maximum biodiesel yield of 98.74% was obtained under optimized transesterification conditions of 30 mg catalyst, a 12 : 1 methanol/oil ratio, 65 °C, and 210 min.
